in_hebrew.name: Hugo
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Intellect, mind, think
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Hugo הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. The name Hugo is derived from the Latin word hugus, which means 'mind, intellect, think'. In Christian tradition, the name Hugo is believed to represent a strong and intelligent individual, who is deeply thoughtful and wise. The name has its roots in the Latin language, but it also has connections to the Germanic language, where it is derived from the word Hug, which means 'heart, mind, spirit'. The name Hugo has been popular throughout history, with many notable figures bearing the name, including Saint Hugo of Grenoble and Saint Hugo of Lincoln.

in_latin.name: Hugo
in_latin.meaning: Homo novus, meaning 'new man' or 'new man in Christ'
in_latin.long_meaning: Hugo derivatur a verbis Latine 'homo' et 'novus', significans virum Christianum qui se mutavit et reformat in imaginem Dei, novus homo in Christo. Hoc nomen origine Latinum venit ex lingua Teutonica, ubi significabat 'homo novus', qui reformat in fidem Christianam, et in nova vita, in Christo, vivit. In Ecclesia Christiana, nomen Hugo significat virum qui novus est, qui se mutavit et reformat in fidem Christi. Hoc nomen saeculo XIII apparuit in Europae occidentali, ubi fuit populare inter Christianos. Hodiernus Hugo significat virum Christianum qui novus est, qui se mutavit et reformat in imaginem Dei, et in nova vita, in Christo, vivit.
